function.name: scan_tree
function.description: Scan a directory tree and return its structure with file/folder counts. The path must be within the allowed roots configured in allowed_roots.json.

rootPath.description: Absolute path to the directory to scan, e.g. 'S:/Archivist-Agent'

function.name: summarize_folder
function.description: Classify files in a folder into 6 buckets (runtime, interface, memory, verification, research, unknown) and return counts and key files per bucket.

rootPath.description: Absolute path to the folder to summarize

function.name: agent_list_directory
function.description: List contents of a directory. Returns name, path, is_dir, size_bytes, and extension for each entry. Directories listed first, then files, alphabetically.

path.description: Absolute path to the directory to list

function.name: agent_read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a single file, optionally paginating by line number. Files larger than 1MB are blocked. Secret files (API keys, .env, .pem, etc.) are blocked. Returns the file content, total line count, and pagination metadata. For files over 1000 lines, use offset and limit to read in chunks of 200 lines to avoid truncation.

path.description: Absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: 1-based line number to start reading from. Defaults to 1 (beginning of file). Use this to paginate through large files.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 200 when offset is provided, or the entire file when offset is not provided. Recommended: 200 for large files.

function.name: agent_search_files
function.description: Search for files by name within a directory tree. Case-insensitive substring match. Max depth 8, max 100 results.

path.description: Absolute path to the root directory to search under

query.description: Search query — matches if the query appears in the file or directory name

function.name: read_governance_file
function.description: Read a governance document by name. Available files: BOOTSTRAP, COVENANT, GOVERNANCE, CPS_ENFORCEMENT, VERIFICATION_LANES, CHECKPOINTS, USER_DRIFT_SCORING, RECIPROCAL_ACCOUNTABILITY, now-md

fileName.description: Governance file name without extension, e.g. 'COVENANT' or 'now-md'

function.name: get_cps_score
function.description: Get the current Constitutional Priority Score (CPS). Score >= 10 means the system is healthy. Below 10 blocks operations.

function.name: ping
function.description: Check if the application is responsive. Returns 'pong'.

function.name: git_status
function.description: Get the current git status of the project. Returns branch, staged/unstaged changes, and recent commits.

function.name: check_read_only
function.description: Check if the agent is in read-only mode. In read-only mode, write operations like build_index and build_registry are blocked.

function.name: propose_patch
function.description: Propose a change to a file. The agent provides the complete new file content, and the system generates a diff for the user to review. The user must click 'Apply' to actually write the file — this command does NOT modify anything on its own. Use this when the user asks you to edit, fix, update, or create a file.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the file to modify, e.g. 'S:/Archivist-Agent/ui/app.js'

patchContent.description: The complete new content of the file after the proposed change. For new files, this is the full file content.

function.name: create_file
function.description: Create a new file with the given content. The path must be within allowed roots. When force=true (agent mode), the file is written directly by the backend. When force=false (UI mode, default), the backend validates only and the UI writes the file after operator confirmation. Parent directories are created automatically if needed.

path.description: Absolute path for the new file, e.g. 'S:/Archivist-Agent/src/new_module.rs'

content.description: The content to write into the new file

force.description: If true, the backend writes the file directly (agent mode). If false or omitted, the backend validates only and the UI writes after confirmation. Default: false.

function.name: delete_path
function.description: Delete a file or empty directory. The path must be within allowed roots. Directories must be empty to be deleted. When force=true (agent mode), the path is deleted directly by the backend. When force=false (UI mode, default), the backend validates only and the UI deletes after operator confirmation.

path.description: Absolute path to the file or empty directory to delete, e.g. 'S:/Archivist-Agent/temp.log'

force.description: If true, the backend deletes directly (agent mode). If false or omitted, the backend validates only and the UI deletes after confirmation. Default: false.

function.name: create_directory
function.description: Create a directory and any missing parent directories. The path must be within allowed roots. When force=true (agent mode), the directory is created directly by the backend. When force=false (UI mode, default), the backend validates only and the UI creates after operator confirmation.

path.description: Absolute path for the new directory, e.g. 'S:/Archivist-Agent/src/new_module'

force.description: If true, the backend creates the directory directly (agent mode). If false or omitted, the backend validates only and the UI creates after confirmation. Default: false.
